title: Video Team Action Log Entry
description: One append-only record per editor mutation (architecture.md section 8.2; the OpenReel-pattern steal). File shape: edit/action-log.jsonl = one JSON object per line, each matching this schema. Reverting action N = re-derive the prior segment set via stream copy from inputs_sha; history is never rewritten.

seq.description: Monotonic per project; the log is append-only.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC; operational stamp, never part of any sha.

kind.description: Extensible only via block-catalog.json entries (a new kind must ship with its renderer + gates).

inputs_sha.description: Pinned input set; clip-pinning preflight P2 refuses a stale reference in seconds.

reversible.description: True when the prior state is reconstructible from pinned inputs via stream copy (architecture.md section 7).

veto.description: Human veto state. Fast-lane edits land with veto pending (deliver fast, disclose fully). A vetoed action stays in the log marked vetoed.
